title: Brent sees a fatal motorcycle crash at age five

tellings.quote: when the back tire hits that water, her bike slides, stops, flips her, she goes

plain: In 1968, in the Berkeley Hills of California, a five-year-old boy saw a woman die in a motorcycle crash: as he describes it, "when the back tire hits that water, her bike slides, stops, flips her." Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, tells Michels he saw it himself as that boy, as part of the story of his own early life.
